LESSON: PATH OF ACTION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Path of Action

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Path of Action
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do the lives of practitioners of karma Yoga inspire us?

1. recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding” using a school example.
• Model B for “recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Path of Action.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the lives of practitioners of karma Yoga inspire us?
2. Why do we need to practise Karma Yoga?
3. How do different scriptures guide us on Karma Yoga?
